data.report: November 26, 2026 | 7:37 AM Partly sunny skies are in the forecast today, with a high near 48°F and calm winds. With warmer temperatures on the mountain, expect snow to soften throughout the day and offer some fun, playful turns. 17 lifts are scheduled to operate today, serving 151 open trails and 2,630 acres of skiing and riding terrain across Palisades and Alpine. Today’s Mountain Tip: Beginner terrain at High Camp is now open for the season! Newer skiers and riders can enjoy mellow groomers, wide-open terrain, and some pretty incredible views of Lake Tahoe. See you out there! -Dom For real-time information at your fingertips, download the Ikon Pass App for updates on lift status, events, weather, and more. November 27, 2026 | 6:52 AM Mostly cloudy skies are in the forecast today, with a high near 50°F. Winds will be calm this morning, becoming west around 5 mph. 17 lifts are scheduled to operate today, serving 151 open trails across Palisades and Alpine. Safety Reminder: Early season conditions exist, including low snow, hidden obstacles, and open creeks. Watch for marked and unmarked hazards, and use extra caution when returning to the base area as multiple runs merge together. Stay aware of your surroundings and give other skiers and riders plenty of space. Conditions should be awesome today. Have a great day on the mountain! -Dom For real-time information at your fingertips, download the Ikon Pass App for updates on lift status, events, weather, and more.
